subject: Kickoff: KnowNo-style uncertainty alignment for agent workflows
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off the uncertainty-alignment track. The pain point: our agent workflows either barrel through ambiguous instructions (bad) or ask clarifying questions constantly (worse). The KnowNo framework from our open-source release is the principled middle path — conformal prediction over the planner's options gives statistical guarantees on task completion while minimizing how often we ask a human for help. Crucially it works with LLMs out of the box, no fine-tuning, which keeps us off the training-compute treadmill.

Milestones (Apr 6 - Jul 13):
- May 8: reproduce the released calibration flow on the demo settings
- Jun 12: KnowNo wrapped around one production agent workflow in shadow mode, with our own calibration set
- Jul 8: readout — help-rate vs completion-rate curves, and a ship/hold call

Ivo — staffing and any serving-side needs, please. The calibration-set build is the real work here.

Priya
